Say hello to our newest match, Kalyan and Leon! 
 Thank you to our partners at the Community Living Campaign for introducing Home Match and Leon!
Leon was looking to rent out his spare bedroom for additional income and Kalyan was ready for a fresh start after living with four housemates. The biggest winner is Hawkeye, Leon’s sweet German Shepherd. 
 Kalyan grew up always wishing for a dog, and now he gets to share a home with one. We have a feeling Hawkeye is going to be very spoiled with extra ear scratches.
Welcome to your new home, Kalyan!
